description: Declaration of hardware-accelerated PUSCH decoder functions, configuration, and related enums and structs for 3GPP LTE/NR.

classes.name: hw_accelerator_pusch_dec
classes.description: Abstract class for hardware-accelerated PUSCH decoding operations, providing configuration, execution, and status methods.

methods.name: reserve_queue
methods.description: Reserves a hardware queue from the accelerator.

methods.name: free_queue
methods.description: Frees a hardware queue from the accelerator.

methods.name: configure_operation
methods.description: Configures the decoding operation with specified parameters and optional CB index.

methods.name: read_operation_outputs
methods.description: Reads the output results of the decoding operation, including CRC pass/fail and iteration count.

methods.name: free_harq_context_entry
methods.description: Frees the external HARQ buffer context entry associated with a given absolute CB ID.

methods.name: is_harq_external
methods.description: Checks if an external HARQ buffer is used by the decoder.
